items.metric: People internally displaced by armed conflict
items.method: Human Rights Monitor rolling monitoring estimate compiled from documented displacement across affected regencies.
items.scope: Multiple conflict-affected regencies; not a census and not directly interchangeable with province-specific government figures.
items.uncertainty: HRM describes gaps and changing conditions; use as an attributed monitoring estimate.

items.metric: People reported displaced in Central Papua
items.method: Government / Komnas HAM coordination figure reported publicly during humanitarian-response discussions.
items.scope: Central Papua administrative scope only; shown separately from civil-society monitoring estimates.
items.uncertainty: Administrative and monitoring estimates use different scopes and should not be added together.

items.metric: Civilian deaths recorded by Komnas HAM in the Puncak violence
items.method: Komnas HAM monitoring and investigation summary for the reported violence in Puncak.
items.scope: Civilian deaths recorded by Komnas HAM for this bounded April 2026 episode; not a Papua-wide conflict total.
items.uncertainty: Keep the event scope and attribution attached; do not add this value to broader casualty datasets without deduplication and compatible definitions.

items.method: Nusantara Atlas satellite analysis of primary forest loss.
items.uncertainty: Remote-sensing estimate; forest loss is not synonymous with illegal deforestation.

items.metric: Primary forest loss attributed to the Merauke PSN footprint
items.method: Nusantara Atlas satellite attribution analysis within the project footprint.
items.scope: Primary forest only; separate from the larger natural-ecosystem clearing estimate that also includes savanna, grassland and Melaleuca ecosystems.

items.metric: Remaining tropical ice relative to 1988 area
items.method: WMO regional climate assessment synthesizing glacier observations.
items.scope: Remaining Papuan tropical ice relative to its 1988 area.
items.uncertainty: The 2% figure describes observed remaining area; the possible 2026–2027 disappearance date is a projection and is not stored as an observed value.

items.method: BMKG reported high-confidence satellite hotspot detections during its weekly weather outlook.
items.scope: Thermal anomalies during the stated period.
items.uncertainty: A hotspot is a satellite thermal detection, not by itself a confirmed wildfire or burned-area measurement.
